footer.tagline: Looking for clear boundaries inside complex systems. Notes on software architecture, engineering practice, and the design decisions worth turning over twice.

login.panelTitle: Back to your <hl>workspace</hl>, and the drafts still waiting.
login.panelDescription: Sign in to manage your account and review the devices you have signed in from. Authors and editors go straight to the editorial dashboard.
login.point1: Email and password, with every session visible and revocable
login.point2: Readers land in the account area, staff in the dashboard
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Sign in with your email and password to manage your account or keep writing.
login.invalidCredentials: That email and password do not match. Check them and try again.
login.resetComplete: Your password has been reset. Sign in again.
login.registrationComplete: Your account is ready. Sign in with your email and password.
login.verificationComplete: Email verified. You can sign in now.

register.panelTitle: Come in, and leave your mark at the <hl>boundary</hl>.
register.panelDescription: We confirm the email is yours first, then you pick a name and password. No account exists until that is done.
register.point1: The first step only asks for your email
register.point2: The account is created after verification
register.title: Create account
register.lead: Enter your email and we will send a verification link, valid for 24 hours.
register.verificationInvalid: That verification link is invalid or has expired. Enter your email again to get a new one.
register.notReceived: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder, and confirm the address you entered.

verifyEmail.panelTitle: Confirm your email, then <hl>create</hl> your account.
verifyEmail.panelDescription: Verification takes a deliberate click so that mail clients prefetching the link cannot consume it.
verifyEmail.title: Confirm this email is yours
verifyEmail.lead: Nothing is verified until you press the button, so link scanners opening this page cost you nothing.

completeRegistration.panelTitle: Now set up your profile and finish your <hl>reader account</hl>.
completeRegistration.panelDescription: The account is created only when this step succeeds. Your name and password never travel by email.
completeRegistration.point1: The email is confirmed as yours
completeRegistration.title: Create account
completeRegistration.lead: Your email is verified. Choose a display name and a password.
completeRegistration.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Avoid common passwords and anything from your email address.

forgotPassword.panelTitle: Get back the key to the <hl>boundary</hl>.
forgotPassword.panelDescription: Submit your account email. If the account can be recovered, we will send a reset link that expires quickly.
forgotPassword.point1: Reset links are valid for 60 minutes
forgotPassword.point2: The response never reveals whether an email is registered
forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.lead: Enter the email you sign in with and we will send a reset link.

resetPassword.panelTitle: Set a new key, and a <hl>solid</hl> one.
resetPassword.panelDescription: When this is done, every session on your other devices signs out and you will need the new password.
resetPassword.point1: New passwords need at least 8 characters
resetPassword.point2: A reset link works exactly once
resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.lead: Enter and confirm your new password.
resetPassword.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Common passwords and anything tied to your account are rejected.
resetPassword.invalidPanelDescription: The link may have expired, already been used, or arrived incomplete. You can request a new reset email.
resetPassword.invalidPoint2: A new link invalidates the old one immediately
resetPassword.invalidLead: Request a new reset email and open the link from the most recent message.

mfa.challengeLead: Enter the code from your authenticator, or use a recovery code you have not spent yet.
mfa.enrollLead: Scan the QR code with any TOTP authenticator, then enter the 6-digit code it generates.
mfa.manualKey: Cannot scan? Show the manual key
mfa.recoveryCodesHint: Each recovery code works once. If you lose your phone, they are how you get back in.

errors.emailTaken: That email is already registered. Sign in instead.
errors.resendCooldown: A verification email just went out. Try again in {seconds}s.
errors.sendQuotaExceeded: You have hit the sending limit. Try again in an hour.
errors.serviceUnavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.checkInboxMessage: Verification email sent. Open your inbox to finish.
errors.registrationLinkInvalid: That sign-up link is invalid or has expired. Verify your email again.
errors.registrationAlreadyDone: This email is already registered, or the sign-up link has expired.
errors.passwordTooCommon: That password is too common, or too close to your account details.
errors.passwordTooCommonReset: That password is too common, or too close to your account details.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.passwordSameAsCurrent: The new password must differ from your current one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in ten minutes.
errors.mfaUnavailable: Two-factor is not configured. Contact an administrator.
errors.mfaBindingExpired: This setup session expired. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.githubStaffForbidden: Staff accounts cannot sign in with GitHub. Use your password and two-factor code.
errors.githubEmailUnverified: GitHub did not supply a verified primary email, so sign-in cannot complete.
errors.githubAccountDisabled: This account is disabled and cannot sign in.
errors.githubAccountConflict: This GitHub account conflicts with an existing account. Contact an administrator.
errors.githubFailed: GitHub sign-in failed. Try again shortly.
errors.mfaCodeIncorrect: That code is not correct. Check your device clock and try again.
errors.mfaCodeOrRecoveryIncorrect: That code or recovery code is not correct.
